# Event 8: Act III — Refugees of the European Wars of Religion (Path C Symmachus doubles yield!)
oe_elr.8 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_elr.8.title
	desc = oe_elr.8.desc
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_ely_atlantic_fleet.dds"

	option = {
		name = oe_elr.8.a
		custom_tooltip = oe_elr.8.a.tt
		if = {
			limit = { owns = location:chesapeake }
			location:chesapeake = {
				add_pop = {
					culture = culture:french
					religion = religion:calvinist
					type = pop_type:burghers
					size = 0.65
				}
				add_pop = {
					culture = culture:sephardi
					religion = religion:judaism
					type = pop_type:burghers
					size = 0.45
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:oe_eln_faith_path ?= 3 }
				location:chesapeake = {
					add_pop = {
						culture = culture:english
						religion = religion:lutheran
						type = pop_type:burghers
						size = 0.70
					}
					add_pop = {
						culture = culture:greek_culture
						religion = religion:orthodox
						type = pop_type:clergy
						size = 0.40
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = capital }
			capital = {
				add_pop = {
					culture = culture:french
					religion = religion:calvinist
					type = pop_type:burghers
					size = 0.65
				}
				if = {
					limit = { root = { var:oe_eln_faith_path ?= 3 } }
					add_pop = {
						culture = culture:english
						religion = religion:lutheran
						type = pop_type:burghers
						size = 0.65
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owns = location:manhattan }
			location:manhattan = {
				add_pop = {
					culture = culture:english
					religion = religion:lutheran
					type = pop_type:burghers
					size = 0.50
				}
				if = {
					limit = { root = { var:oe_eln_faith_path ?= 3 } }
					add_pop = {
						culture = culture:sephardi
						religion = religion:judaism
						type = pop_type:burghers
						size = 0.50
					}
				}
			}
		}
		culture = {
			add_cultural_tradition = 8
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 75 }
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_elr.8.b
		custom_tooltip = oe_elr.8.b.tt
		if = {
			limit = { exists = capital }
			capital = {
				add_pop = {
					culture = culture:greek_culture
					religion = root.religion
					type = pop_type:burghers
					size = 0.45
				}
			}
		}
		add_stability = 5
		ai_chance = { base = 25 }
	}
}

# Event 10: Act III — Great Pestilence Quarantine Chain #2: Save the Foederati? (+ Asclepius Easter Egg!)
oe_elr.10 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_elr.10.title
	desc = oe_elr.10.desc
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_ely_chesapeake_landing.dds"

	# Special Path B + v9.8 Asclepius Seated Easter Egg: FREE quarantine & -70% pestilence impact!
	option = {
		name = oe_elr.10.a
		trigger = {
			oe_elr_has_asclepius_seated = yes
		}
		custom_tooltip = oe_elr.10.a.tt
		oe_elr_apply_pestilence_quarantine = yes
		add_stability = 8
		add_prestige = 12
		ai_chance = { base = 100 }
	}

	# Standard Byzantine Physicians & Herbal Quarantine Relief
	option = {
		name = oe_elr.10.b
		custom_tooltip = oe_elr.10.b.tt
		add_gold = -150
		oe_elr_apply_pestilence_quarantine = yes
		add_prestige = 8
		ai_chance = { base = 65 }
	}

	# Guard Only the Hellenic Core Capital
	option = {
		name = oe_elr.10.c
		custom_tooltip = oe_elr.10.c.tt
		oe_elr_init_counters = yes
		set_variable = { name = oe_elr_quarantine_state value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = capital }
			capital = {
				add_location_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_elr_foederati_quarantine_loc_mod
					years = 15
					mode = replace
				}
			}
		}
		add_stability = -5
		ai_chance = { base = 20 }
	}
}

# Event 14: Act IV Stage 1 — Return to the Hesperides: Azores and Gibraltar Staging
oe_elr.14 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_elr.14.title
	desc = oe_elr.14.desc
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_ely_atlantic_fleet.dds"

	# Act I Azores Beacon Shortcut (when oe_ely_azores_beacon set & Azores anchorage unowned)
	option = {
		name = oe_elr.14.a
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				has_variable = oe_ely_azores_beacon
				has_global_variable = oe_ely_azores_beacon
			}
			OR = {
				location:angra = { has_owner = no }
				location:ponta_delgada = { has_owner = no }
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = oe_elr.14.a.tt
		set_variable = oe_elr_azores_staging_done
		if = {
			limit = { location:angra = { has_owner = no } }
			location:angra = {
				change_location_owner = root
				add_core = root
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { location:ponta_delgada = { has_owner = no } }
			location:ponta_delgada = {
				change_location_owner = root
				add_core = root
			}
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_elr_azores_staging_mod
			years = 25
			mode = replace
		}
		oe_elr_grant_nostos_cbs = yes
		ai_chance = { base = 90 }
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_elr.14.b
		custom_tooltip = oe_elr.14.b.tt
		set_variable = oe_elr_azores_staging_done
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_elr_azores_staging_mod
			years = 25
			mode = replace
		}
		location:gibraltar = { discover_location = root }
		location:ponta_delgada = { discover_location = root }
		location:angra = { discover_location = root }
		oe_elr_grant_nostos_cbs = yes
		add_prestige = 8
		ai_chance = { base = 60 }
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_elr.14.c
		custom_tooltip = oe_elr.14.c.tt
		set_variable = oe_elr_azores_staging_done
		add_gold = -200
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_elr_azores_staging_mod
			years = 30
			mode = replace
		}
		add_navy_tradition = 12
		oe_elr_grant_nostos_cbs = yes
		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
	}
}

			}
		}
		add_prestige = 15
		add_navy_tradition = 10
		ai_chance = { base = 100 }
	}
}

# Event 16: Act IV Stage 3 — The Flame Returns! Eagles Over the Theodosian Walls
oe_elr.16 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_elr.16.title
	desc = oe_elr.16.desc
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_elr_nostos_return.dds"

	immediate = {
		oe_elr_set_nostos_stage = { STAGE = 3 }
	}

	# Path A: Orthodox Rededication of Hagia Sophia
	option = {
		name = oe_elr.16.a
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				var:oe_eln_faith_path ?= 1
				AND = {
					exists = religion
					religion ?= religion:orthodox
				}
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = oe_elr.16.a.tt
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_elr_flame_returned_mod
			years = 30
			mode = replace
		}
		add_prestige = 30
		add_legitimacy = 20
		add_stability = 10
		ai_chance = { base = 80 }
	}

	# Path B: Religio Romana / Sol Invictus & Atlantic Pantheon Triumph
	option = {
		name = oe_elr.16.b
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				var:oe_eln_faith_path ?= 2
				AND = {
					exists = religion
					religion ?= religion:hellenism_religion
				}
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = oe_elr.16.b.tt
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_elr_flame_returned_mod
			years = 30
			mode = replace
		}
		oe_romp_ensure_omens_unlocked = yes
		add_prestige = 35
		add_legitimacy = 20
		culture = {
			add_cultural_tradition = 12
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 80 }
	}

	# Path C / Universal Civic & Ecumenical Jubilee of the Two-Headed Eagle
	option = {
		name = oe_elr.16.c
		custom_tooltip = oe_elr.16.c.tt
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_elr_flame_returned_mod
			years = 30
			mode = replace
		}
		add_prestige = 25
		add_stability = 12
		culture = {
			add_cultural_tradition = 10
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 50 }
	}
}

		custom_tooltip = oe_elr.18.a.tt

		ai_chance = { base = 30 }
	}

	# Ending A2: Return of the Flame — Charter Regnum Novae Elysiae Viceroyalty Dominion

		trigger = {
			any_owned_location = { continent = continent:america }
		}
		custom_tooltip = oe_elr.18.b.tt
		oe_elr_apply_ending_return_viceroy = yes
		ai_chance = { base = 25 }

		name = oe_elr.18.c
		custom_tooltip = oe_elr.18.c.tt
		oe_elr_apply_ending_imperium_bicephalum = yes
		ai_chance = { base = 45 }
	}
}

	desc = oe_elr.19.desc
	outcome = positive

		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_elr_nostos_ended } }

		}
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_elr.19.a
		custom_tooltip = oe_elr.19.a.tt
		add_prestige = 25
		add_stability = 10
		culture = {
			add_cultural_tradition = 20
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 100 }
	}
}
